gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK sets large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance, and its brush ends lift away before each curve closes. Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls against that sans give the pair its strongest quality: vintage force meeting clean restraint.

gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Chiseled, vintage and loud: Woodgod's wide channels and nearly capital-height lowercase command the heading. And Noto Sans Khmer, a plain sans, keeps generous openings like chisel notches, so its proud small letters read steadily over a long stretch.
